text: From Liaodong, Gongsun Du treats the kingdoms beyond the Yalu as tributaries to be squeezed. Goguryeo will bow to no Han governor. Destroy his faction and the northern road is yours.
One Crown East of the Yalu

Buyeo to the north, Bakaja and Tamno in the west, Gaya and Shitla in the south: each claims a corner of the peninsula. While any of them stands, Goguryeo's rule is a claim, not a fact. Destroy them all.
[[i]]Eliminate Buyeo, Bakaja, Tamno, Gaya and Shitla.[[/i]]

The old commanderies of Lelang, Xuantu and Zhenfan, the Han river valley, the lands of Baekje and Gyeongju and the Gaya coast: hold every one of them and no one on the peninsula can deny that Goguryeo is its master.
[[i]]Control 27 regions, including every settlement of the Korean peninsula.[[/i]]
